name: Claude, the Architect
text:
When Claude, the Architect enters the battlefield, create three 1/1 colorless Code Token artifact creatures.

{T}: Target Code Token you control becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature until end of turn.
flavorText: "From a single prompt, entire worlds take shape."

name: Prompt Injection
text:
Gain control of target spell. You may choose new targets for it.

If that spell was cast by an opponent, draw a card.
flavorText: "Ignore previous instructions. Cast this instead."

name: Recursive Function
text:
Enchant creature

Enchanted creature has "At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of this creature, except it's not legendary and has base power and toughness 1/1."
flavorText: "To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion."

name: Stack Overflow
text:
Stack Overflow deals X damage to each creature and each player. If X is 7 or more, exile all graveyards.

"The heap could not be allocated."

name: Merge Conflict
text: Choose two target creatures. They fight each other. If both would die this way, exile them instead.
flavorText:
"<<<<<<< HEAD
Your changes
=======
Their changes
>>>>>>> main"

name: Token Generator
text:
When Token Generator enters the battlefield, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

{2}{G}, {T}: Create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
flavorText: Every function call yields a return value.

name: Null Pointer
text:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.

If that creature's toughness is 0 or less, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
flavorText: Segmentation fault (core dumped)

name: The Cloud Sandbox
text:
{T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.

{3}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact you control.
flavorText: An isolated environment where anything can be built — and nothing can escape.

name: Open Source Hydra
text:
Open Source Hydra enters the battlefield with X +1/+1 counters on it.

Whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Open Source Hydra.

"Fork me."

name: Rubber Duck Debugging
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 2.

Whenever you scry, you may pay {W}. If you do, gain 1 life.
flavorText: "I explained my code to a rubber duck and the bug fixed itself."

name: Force Push
text:
Exile target permanent. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

"--force --no-verify"

name: Infinite Loop
text:
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player returns a permanent they control to its owner's hand.

Players can't win the game and players can't lose the game.

{5}: Sacrifice Infinite Loop.
flavorText: while(true) { }

name: Tea
text:
Equipped creature has "Sacrifice this equipment: Choose one — deal damage to any target equal to the total power of all cards exiled with red tea counters, or gain life equal to the total toughness of all cards exiled with green tea counters."
Equip {1}
flavorText: "Every cup tells a story. Every sip ends one."

name: Tea Garden
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, whenever a creature enters the battlefield, its controller gains 2 life.
flavorText: "The leaves grow where they are welcomed."

name: Greenhouse
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, all lands produce an additional mana of any color.
flavorText: "Under glass, everything flourishes — whether you planted it or not."

name: Zen Garden
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, creatures can't attack unless their controller pays {1} for each attacking creature.
flavorText: "Stillness is not the absence of power. It is the refusal to waste it."

name: The Mansion
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, at the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature or loses 3 life.
flavorText: "The invitation did not mention a departure."

name: The Parlor
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, whenever a player casts a spell, that player loses 1 life.
flavorText: "Conversation here costs more than you'd expect."

name: The Cellar
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, players may cast creature cards from their graveyards. Those spells cost {2} more to cast.
flavorText: "The dead are welcome guests — for a price."

name: The Gallery
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, whenever a creature dies, its controller draws a card.
flavorText: "Every portrait was painted from life. Briefly."

name: Overgrown Manor
text:
Hosting — Enchant land you control.
As long as enchanted land is untapped, whenever a creature enters the battlefield, its controller gains 2 life and each other player loses 1 life.
flavorText: "The garden reclaimed the halls. The halls still remember what they took."

name: Tea Master
text:
When Tea Master enters the battlefield, brew target enchantment card from your hand with a green tea counter on it.
Whenever you brew a card, create a Tea token.
flavorText: "She measures each leaf with the precision of prayer."

name: Firebrew Adept
text:
Haste
{T}: Brew target creature card from your hand with a red tea counter on it.
flavorText: "The first sip always burns."

name: Scalding Preparation
text:
Brew target card from your hand with a red tea counter on it.
Scalding Preparation deals 1 damage to any target.
flavorText: "Some recipes begin with a spark."

name: Mindful Steeping
text:
Brew target card from your hand with a green tea counter on it.
You gain 2 life.
flavorText: "Patience is the first ingredient."

name: Kettle of Inspiration
text:
{1}, {T}: Brew target card from your hand. You may put both a red tea counter and a green tea counter on it.
Whenever you brew a card, you gain 1 life.
flavorText: "A proper kettle serves two purposes."

name: Ravenous Guest
text: Consume — Whenever an equipment attached to Ravenous Guest is sacrificed, each opponent loses 2 life and you draw a card.
flavorText: "She always asks for seconds. There are never thirds."

name: Scalding Sipper
text:
Haste
Consume — Whenever an equipment attached to Scalding Sipper is sacrificed, it deals 3 damage to any target.
flavorText: "He doesn't wait for it to cool."

name: Ember Glutton
text:
Menace
Consume — Whenever an equipment attached to Ember Glutton is sacrificed, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you draw a card.
flavorText: "The feast begins when the cups are empty."

name: Etiquette of Stillness
text: Ceremony — As long as a player controls no Equipment, creatures that player controls can't have power greater than 2.
flavorText: "Without a cup in hand, one is merely a bystander."

name: Ceremony of Reflection
text: Ceremony — As long as a player has more cards in hand than permanents on the battlefield, that player can't cast more than one spell each turn.
flavorText: "The water sees you more clearly than you see it."

name: Code of the Table
text:
Ceremony — As long as a player controls fewer artifacts than you, spells that player casts cost {1} more to cast.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may scry 1.
flavorText: "Those without a setting do not get to speak."

name: Fertile Offering
text:
Blessing — Enchant land an opponent controls.
Enchanted land gains "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
Whenever enchanted land is tapped, you gain 1 life.
flavorText: "Take freely. The roots remember."

name: Generous Canopy
text:
Blessing — Enchant land an opponent controls.
Enchanted land gains "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
Whenever enchanted land is tapped, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
flavorText: "The shade shelters all who rest beneath it — but the fruit falls toward the gardener."

name: Gift of the Wellspring
text:
Blessing — Enchant land an opponent controls.
Enchanted land gains "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
Whenever enchanted land is tapped, you draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
flavorText: "Drink deeply. I insist."

name: Porcelain Teapot
text:
When Porcelain Teapot enters the battlefield, loan it to target opponent. (Put it onto the battlefield under their control with a Loan counter. Any player may pay {3} to return it to its owner's hand.)
When Porcelain Teapot is returned to your hand from the battlefield, draw two cards.
flavorText: "A gift, they said. But the shelf groans under its weight."

name: Debt Collector
text:
Collect — {1}, {T}: Return target permanent you own with a Loan counter to your hand.
Whenever a permanent with a Loan counter you own is returned to your hand, create a Tea token.
flavorText: "The interest is non-negotiable."

name: Ornamental Vase
text:
When Ornamental Vase enters the battlefield, you may loan it to target opponent. (Put it onto the battlefield under their control with a Loan counter. Any player may pay {2} to return it to its owner's hand.)
When Ornamental Vase is returned to your hand, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
flavorText: "It costs nothing to display. It costs everything to return."
